scope: Bounded current static machine contract only; no full transcript, incoming-reference denominator, unfinished owned pins/predictions or replay framework review. No emulator, instruction interpreter, target compiler or original execution.

confirmed.derivation: ORR uses old r2 LSL1; MOV LSL16 and EOR operand LSR16 retain only low16 of OR term. Seed0 and XOR of two16-bit operands keep r2 zero-extended16.
confirmed.read_order: Initial B reaches precheck at+24. Nonzero CMP/BNE reaches body+8, rereads same address with postincrement1, then returns to precheck. Stable n nonzero bytes require2n+1 loads; terminal zero is read once and never folded.
confirmed.return: r0=r2=h, r1=0 at normal return, including empty string h=0.
confirmed.registers_and_memory: Only r0,r1,r2 and NZCV written before return; no memory stores or stack access; r3..r12,sp,lr unchanged. BX lr uses LR as control input.
confirmed.NZCV: Final CMP 0,#0 gives N0 Z1 C1 V0; following MOV has S=0 and BX does not change NZCV. Incoming NZCV not consumed before CMP.
confirmed.preconditions: Stable readable bytes through reachable NUL justify sequence recurrence and load count; return additionally assumes valid LR/control context. No pointer-null test or input ownership/type inference.

findings.claim: no additional incoming register/stack value consumed
findings.correction: No additional incoming data argument or stack value consumed; incoming LR supplies the return target. Qualify normal-return context accordingly.
findings.impact: Precision of machine input contract; arithmetic and stored-memory preconditions unchanged.
